data.title: Anthropic Races to Defend Enterprise AI Lead Against OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra But Weighs Safety Concerns: Report
data.description: Anthropic is weighing a new AI model to counter OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra amid rising competition and safety concerns.

data.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Rejects Calls to Slow Down AI Development: ‘We Are Going to Go as Fast We Can, But…'
data.description: Huang backed rapid AI development, saying the industry should move “as fast as we can” while ensuring products are safe before release.

data.title: Sam Altman Heads to UN Security Council, Prepares to Brief World Powers on AI Safety Amid Global Regulation Push: Report
data.description: Sam Altman is expected to brief the UN Security Council on AI risks, safety standards and international coordination.

data.title: Trump Escalates Economic Pressure on Russia With New Sanctions Law That Could Hit Moscow’s Biggest Trading Partners With Tariffs
data.description: On Friday, Trump signed a sweeping Russia sanctions law expanding pressure on Moscow and its trading partners.

data.title: Trump Escalates Fight With Media, Bans CNN, MS NOW and Politico From White House, Warns More Could Face Same Fate
data.description: Trump barred some media houses from the White House, prompting constitutional concerns and potential legal challenges over press access.
